Container.Name: cache-puller
Container.Overview: Tracks which files on your shares are used most and safely moves them from the array to the share's cache pool (for shares with a pool as primary and the array as secondary storage). Has a web UI for status, the list of frequently used files and all settings. Starts in DRY RUN mode: review the plan in the web UI, then switch dry run off there. Needs --pid=host and SYS_PTRACE to see which files are open and whether the mover is running, and SYS_ADMIN plus DAC_READ_SEARCH to watch whole disks without scanning every folder.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI.

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: Optional. Protects the web UI (log in with any user name and this password).

Config.Name: Mount root
Config.Description: Must be /mnt mapped to /mnt, so array disks, pools and paths in the mover ignore list match the host.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, mover ignore list and transfer journal.

Config.Name: Share configs
Config.Description: Unraid share settings (read-only).

Config.Name: emhttp state
Config.Description: Array/parity state (read-only).

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: Starting value only: settings changed in the web UI take precedence.

Config.Name: Include shares
Config.Description: Comma separated. Empty = every share whose secondary storage is the array.

Config.Name: Exclude shares
Config.Description: Comma separated shares to never touch.

Config.Name: Cache max usage %
Config.Description: Never fill the pool above this. Cold promoted files are moved back when it's exceeded.

Config.Name: Cache min free
Config.Description: Always keep at least this much free on the pool.

Config.Name: Min score
Config.Description: How 'hot' a file must be. Roughly the number of separate accesses, decaying with the half-life.

Config.Name: Half-life (hours)
Config.Description: How fast old accesses stop counting.

Config.Name: Run interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to move files.

Config.Name: Allowed hours
Config.Description: Only move files during these hours, e.g. 1-6. Empty = any time.

Config.Name: Mover ignore file
Config.Description: File list of hot files on the pool, for the Mover Tuning plugin's 'ignore files listed in a text file' option (host path: your appdata folder). Empty = disabled.

Config.Name: Exclude patterns
Config.Description: Comma separated glob patterns (matched against the path inside the share and the file name).

Config.Name: Min file size
Config.Description: Skip smaller files, e.g. 1M.

Config.Name: Max file size
Config.Description: Skip larger files, e.g. 100G. 0 = no limit.

Config.Name: Max GB per run
Config.Description: Upper bound on data moved per cycle.

Config.Name: Verify
Config.Description: hash = re-read and checksum every copy before deleting the original; size = compare size only.

Config.Name: Share modes
Config.Description: Which mover directions to manage: yes (pool to array), prefer (array to pool).

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING
